description: This file defines a React functional component 'MCPToolConfiguration' which manages the display and configuration of tools fetched from an MCP server. It includes state handling for loading, errors, and user interactions for selecting/deselecting tools. It also uses hooks to manage side effects related to tool loading.

methods.name: MCPToolConfiguration
methods.description: React functional component for configuring tools fetched from an MCP server, with UI for selecting tools and handling loading/error states.
